message.headline: From first click to happy customer
message.promise: Build, operate and continuously optimize a measurable acquisition funnel through media, landing pages and appointment follow-up.
message.positioning: PlusLeads sells the connection between traffic, lead status, appointments and customer outcomes rather than isolated lead volume.
message.audience: Companies seeking an end-to-end acquisition partner · Teams willing to share downstream lead-status feedback · Selected verticals for pay-per-lead

forms.friction: Product choices included home batteries, solar, air conditioning and heat pumps.

fields: Calendly date and time visible before later questions

funnel.detail: The visitor chooses an interactive scan or a 30-minute meeting.
ICP, proposition and commercial goals are defined.
Email, landing pages, ads and full tracking are prepared.
The client follows up or PlusLeads books appointments.
Campaign and downstream lead-status data are reviewed weekly before scaling.

pricing: Pay-per-lead available only in selected niches
Media budget is separate and may be paid directly
contract: One-month notice at the end of a calendar month
guarantee: Terms state that leads and results are forecasts rather than guarantees unless explicitly agreed in writing.

proof: Claims and model assumptions were self-reported
contradictions: contract-qualification — The marketing statement is directionally true but incomplete. — The site says there are no long contracts. — Terms specify an initial period, silent monthly renewal and one-month notice at month-end.

forecast-versus-guarantee — Calculator outputs must be labeled as scenarios. — The calculator communicates appointment and deal potential. — Terms state forecasts are not guarantees unless agreed in writing.
proof-definition — Each count needs a definition and period. — The site references 150+ customers and trust from 50+ companies. — The relationship between those totals was not explained.
inferences: The scan is designed to convert uncertainty into a quantified sales conversation. — confidence: high — basis: It captures market, region and product inputs and promises growth and competitor analysis.
Weekly lead-status analysis is the main operational differentiation. — confidence: high — basis: The public four-step process explicitly feeds downstream status back into campaign optimization.
notObservable: Calendly questions after selecting a time
limitations: The scan was not advanced or submitted.
Public performance claims and calculator assumptions were not independently audited.

copy: Use an interactive scan as a value-first CTA
Connect campaign optimization to downstream lead status
Show the four operational stages clearly
State whether the client or provider handles appointment setting
avoid: Presenting forecast outputs as expected facts
test: Market scan versus direct calendar booking
A closed-loop dashboard from click through appointment and sale
